properties.name: Transbay Terminal
properties.geometry_method: Traced by eye from USGS San Francisco North 1:24,000 (1950) (1 hand-read points). The middle of the station building on the 1950 sheet ("Key System Terminal").

sources.note: "the Bridge Railway terminal is on Mission street between First and Fremont."
Six station tracks, 700 ft long; Interurban trains on the three north tracks, Key System and Sacramento Northern trains on the other three (p. 150).
"The last trains crossed the Bay Bridge in 1958" (p. 215); buses used the terminal from 1959.

properties.notes: Its rail years only; buses used it from 1959 until 2010.
